channel.title: Comments on: So, I’d like to ask…
channel.description: taoism, taoist thought, buddha, yoga, tai chi, shakuhachi

item.title: By: Dan Littler
item.dc:creator: Dan Littler
item.description:
Cheers Carl. Good stuff as always. I haven't been on the site in a few weeks, but I found myself back here today (I always come here when I'm particularly lost and need reminding how and why to take the middle path). You always remind me that when I'm worrying about something, the best course of action to take is to deal with the worrying, rather than trying to take rash action to resolve the situation before I've had a chance to properly understand it.
More stuff to ponder indeed. Dan.

item.title: By: Matt Logan
item.dc:creator: Matt Logan
item.description:
Hi Carl,
Thanks for this post. I hope Dan found something in it because I certainly did. Recently I've been worrying about far too many things that I (society?) feel I 'should' be doing, and getting less and less actually done. Your thoughts and words seem strangely relevant to my situation but not in a way I can properly explain. I guess everyone grows uniquely, in their own proper time and place and even in our minds we can't hasten this process. Hmmm. More stuff to ponder I guess.
Matt
